groups.why_chosen: Same 3x4 data-parallel x pipeline-stage worker grid drawn twice: one clustered whole-column failure (checkpoint needed) versus scattered failures leaving one live worker per column (training survives).
groups.what_to_learn: Ring one whole failed column in a dashed box labelled by name for the worst case; for the survivable case, scatter the same failure icons so every column still keeps one active worker — but red/black arrows go unexplained.
